name: The Other World
source:
In a broken world, someone wanders trying to do nothing more than avoid things from the other world.

[From [url=http://neotable.blogspot.com/p/other-world.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
在一个残破的世界里，某人四处流浪，唯一想做的只是避开来自异世界的种种事物。

[摘自[url=http://neotable.blogspot.com/p/other-world.html]官方网站[/url]]
